name: 玻尿酸冰感水润贴片面膜款
description: 玻尿酸补水保湿、冰感水润质地、温和清透贴肤

styleLock.backgroundSystem: airy white-to-ice-blue gradients #F4FAFD to #DFF1F8 with a subtle water-wave sheen
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft cool studio lighting, front-left key, dewy glistening droplets, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: frosted light-stone counter #DCE8EE and glossy wet-look ice-blue panel #A9D3E6
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in dark teal-charcoal #223744, all copy wrapped in 「」; aloe-green #7CB25A reserved for botanical accent props and thin-line leaf icons, not for text
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line water-drop and leaf icons in one accent color #2E9BC0
styleLock.presentationRules: flat sachets and box standing upright with glistening water droplets, stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale across the set, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool hydrating skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of airy white #F4FAFD, glacier blue #A9D3E6, one deep lake-blue accent #2E9BC0 and dark teal-charcoal text #223744, with aloe-green #7CB25A appearing only in botanical accent props such as aloe leaf slices; bright soft cool studio lighting with a front-left key, dewy glistening water droplets and soft contact shadows; airy white-to-ice-blue gradient backgrounds with a subtle water-wave sheen; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in #223744 with all copy wrapped in 「」; consistent thin-line water-drop icon style; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright sachet presentation; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 从 8 张玻尿酸贴片面膜爆款详情图提炼；已剥离源品牌店招、二维码、原文案与未证实的功效宣称；旧版承诺镜中的空徽章槽改为封边工艺与精华质地特写的可验证呈现；产品一律以 {product} 占位，可复用于任意玻尿酸补水贴片面膜。
